title: CodexBar toy Upstash payload (inner, decoded from the {"result":"..."} envelope)
description: Hand-maintained. Producer: scripts/codexbar-stats.sh --json (usage % + extra-usage $) augmented by scripts/codexbar-publish.sh (Claude/Codex cost rollups from CodexBar's local cost caches plus the reduced Pi Agent provider from scripts/pi-agent-stats.sh, the LM Studio provider from scripts/lmstudio-stats.sh, the Ollama provider from scripts/ollama-stats.sh, and optional per-provider `cu` on `cursor` from scripts/cursor-stats.sh). Consumer: firmware/main/stats_model.{h,c}. v1 = pre-cost {id,ok,p?,pr?,s?,sr?}; v2 is a strict superset adding optional per-provider `cost`, `ph`, `pi`, `lm`, `ol`, and `cu` objects. Firmware accepts v1 and v2; rejects other versions.

p.description: Primary/session used %. Typically 0-100; Pi compares today to the prior 29-day peak and may exceed 100.

cost.description: v2 optional. Present for providers with a generic cost payload (Claude/Codex cost-cache rollups; OpenRouter live keyDataFetched fields; Ramp Router dashboard-API rollups via ramp-stats.sh; DeepSeek platform-dashboard rollups via deepseek-stats.sh; Moonshot/Qwen Cloud token slices DERIVED from local Pi Agent sessions via pi-agent-stats.sh). Money is integer CENTS (LVGL has no float printf). Pi uses the sibling `pi` block instead; firmware still maps it into cost-card-capable fields.

xu.description: Extra-usage overage used, cents (providerCost.used for Claude; keyUsage for OpenRouter). NOT total spend.

xl.description: Extra-usage overage limit, cents (providerCost.limit for Claude; keyLimit for OpenRouter).

ct.description: Total spend for the local calendar day, cents (Claude/Codex: publisher rollup from cost cache; OpenRouter: keyUsageDaily; DeepSeek: usage/cost day bucket matching the local date — the API pre-buckets days in its own timezone, so this is USD-only and may be offset by up to a day boundary).

cm.description: Total spend trailing 30 days, cents (Claude cost cache only).

tt.description: Tokens for the local calendar day (Claude/Codex cost-cache rollups sum model tokens; OpenRouter sums prompt+completion from analytics/query hourly buckets folded into local days; DeepSeek sums all non-REQUEST usage types across models from usage/amount, on the API's own pre-bucketed day; Moonshot/Qwen Cloud are DERIVED from Pi Agent session rows attributed by provider, a deliberate UNDERCOUNT that sees only Pi-routed traffic).

tm.description: Tokens trailing 30 days (Claude cost cache; Qwen Cloud derived from Pi Agent sessions — it draws the standard card, whose 30-day row is the only place its derived total can surface).

cw.description: Spend this week, cents (OpenRouter: keyUsageWeekly; DeepSeek: trailing 7 days inclusive of today, summed from the daily cost series).

cr.description: Account balance remaining, cents (OpenRouter dedicated balance or Balance display string; generic credits.remaining where provided; Moonshot/DeepSeek balance display strings; Ramp remaining_credit_usd). Firmware credits_remaining_c.

cl.description: Total account credits, cents (OpenRouter: totalCredits; Ramp total_credits_usd). Firmware credits_limit_c.

h.description: Per-day total spend, cents, oldest -> newest (Claude and Ramp; firmware caps at STATS_HIST_MAX=31).

ht.description: Per-day TOKEN totals, oldest -> newest. Sibling of `h` (daily spend cents), mirroring the pi.h/pi.ht pairing. OpenRouter, DeepSeek, and Moonshot (Moonshot derived from Pi Agent sessions); zero-filled on days with no activity. Only published for providers whose card charts it — the balance card. Firmware caps at STATS_HIST_MAX=31.

ph.description: v2 optional, Claude only. ~24h SESSION usage-% history (0..100), oldest -> newest, from CodexBar's hourly history file. Usage %, NOT cost. Absent => firmware pct_hist_n=0. Caps at STATS_PCT_HIST_MAX=24.

pi.description: v2 optional, Pi provider only. Privacy-reduced Pi Agent rollup from ~/.pi/agent/sessions JSONL files. Present only on provider id `pi`; no raw prompts, cwd/project paths, model names, response IDs, or credentials are published.

ts.description: Today's Pi Agent spend, integer CENTS, using the publisher's LOCAL calendar day (was UTC before 2026-08-21; UTC rolled Pi's day over mid-afternoon in US timezones and disagreed with every neighbouring tile).

tt.description: Today's Pi Agent tokens, using the publisher's LOCAL calendar day.

ps.description: Max daily Pi Agent spend over the last 30 calendar days, integer CENTS.

pt.description: Max daily Pi Agent tokens over the last 30 calendar days.

h.description: Pi Agent daily spend history, integer cents, oldest -> newest, one point per calendar day. Firmware caps at STATS_HIST_MAX.

ht.description: Pi Agent daily TOKEN history, oldest -> newest, one point per calendar day. Sibling of `h` (daily spend cents); drives the summary bar's today-vs-30-day-daily-average comparison (excluding 0-use days). Firmware caps at STATS_HIST_MAX.

lm.description: v2 optional, LM Studio provider only. Local inference metrics from ~/.lmstudio/server-logs/. Present only on provider id `lmstudio`.

id.description: Model identifier from LM Studio request body.

models.description: Top-10 models by request count today.

oc.description: v2 optional, OpenCode Go provider only. Token rollup + today's cost from opencode.ai API. Present only on provider id `opencodego`; workos-session cookie never published.

ht.description: Daily token totals, oldest -> newest. Firmware caps at STATS_HIST_MAX.

cu.description: v2 optional, Cursor provider only. Mac-local daily token rollup from scripts/cursor-stats.sh merged by codexbar-publish.sh. Present only on provider id `cursor`; WorkosCursorSessionToken never published.

sess.description: true when the Mac Keychain Cursor session validated on last publish; false means re-run --set-cursor-session (device may show a summary hint).

ht.description: Daily token totals, oldest -> newest. Firmware caps at STATS_HIST_MAX.

ol.description: v2 optional, Ollama provider only. Local inference metrics from Ollama server. Present only on provider id `ollama`.

$comment: Cost source is CodexBar's local cache ~/Library/Caches/CodexBar/cost-usage/claude-v*.json days[date][model]=[input,cacheRead,cacheCreate,output,costNanos,rows,rows] (verified 2026-05-18). Only the `days` aggregate is read; the cache `files` map (private project paths) never leaves the Mac. Relaxed single-user privacy model: docs/SECURITY.md.
